name: mercy-the-stylish
description: Convenience scripts for running the whole Mercy the Stylish project locally. The actual apps live in app/, server/, and ai-server/ - each has its own package.json.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix ai-server && npm install --prefix app
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,ai-server,app -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix ai-server" "npm run dev --prefix app"
scripts.test:all: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix ai-server && npm test --prefix app
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix ai-server && npm run build --prefix app
